The uploading APIs are designed to ensure reliability for large files, even over an unreliable connection.
A successful response provides a set of operations you will use to upload the asset.
A set of operations that you use to upload the parts of the asset to App Store Connect.
Use the upload operations returned in the response to your reservation request to upload your asset to App Store Connect.
You don’t need to supply a JWT; don’t share the URLs.
After you’ve uploaded all parts of your asset to App Store Connect, you must commit the reservation.
If the total bytes received don’t match the file size value in the reservation, the commit request fails.
If you need to update your asset after committing it, you must delete it and create another upload, beginning with an asset reservation.
Use the API to re-fetch the asset at any time to check on its status.
To upload your asset you must delete the asset record and retry your upload, beginning with making an asset reservation.
